retrievalProfile.description: A split-composition layout featuring a torn-paper upper section for heavy display type and a lower photographic section with a muted, vintage color palette.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition divided by a diagonal, jagged 'torn paper' edge. The top section is a solid white field containing three lines of massive, black, ultra-bold slab serif text. The bottom section is a grainy, low-contrast photograph of a person in a tropical shirt standing by a car at a coastal location under a hazy, overcast sky.
coreVisualRelationships: The jagged torn edge creates a physical barrier between the graphic text and the photographic subject.
The heavy black typography anchors the top-heavy composition.
Muted blues and greens in the photo contrast with the stark black-on-white graphic header.
The subject's central position provides a stable vertical axis against the diagonal tear.
coreInvariants: Jagged, irregular torn paper texture on the bottom edge of the white block.
Ultra-bold, tightly tracked slab serif typography.
Muted, slightly desaturated photographic color grading.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The human subject is centered in the lower two-thirds of the frame, medium shot from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large-scale black typography in the top third acts as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the heavy text, follow the torn edge downward, and land on the subject's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space in the top corners and around the central text block.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted Cyan and Sage Green (photographic elements)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast in the graphic section; low saturation and mid-tone values in the photographic section.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Ultra-bold slab serif with square terminals
letterConstructionRules: Extremely thick strokes with minimal contrast
Tight letter spacing (kerning) causing characters to nearly touch
Uniform cap height across all lines
characterSpecificRedesigns: The bottom of the third line is partially obscured or 'torn' by the paper edge texture

composition.relationshipToImage: Overlaid on white block above image

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family dominance; no secondary typeface used.

avoid: Clean vector edges on the tear

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serifs and blocky structure.
Provides the necessary geometric slab weight.
Similar vintage slab serif feel with tight counters.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vintage-style photograph of a man in a patterned short-sleeve shirt standing by a light blue classic car on a hazy beach road. Apply a grainy film texture and muted 1980s color grading. Leave the top 40% of the frame as a solid white block with a jagged, realistic torn-paper bottom edge that overlaps the photo.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Typeset three lines of text in an ultra-bold slab serif font (like Stymie Black) in solid black. Align the text to the top left within the white block. Ensure the bottom line of text is partially clipped by the jagged torn edge of the white block.

verificationChecks: Is the paper edge jagged and realistic?
Is the typography ultra-bold slab serif?
Is the photo color-graded with a muted, vintage feel?
Does the text nearly touch due to tight tracking?

mustRedesign: Avoid using the specific artist's face
Do not replicate the exact brand of the car
postGenerationChecks: Check that the torn edge looks like physical paper.
Ensure the text is solid black without digital glow.
Verify the photo has a 1980s film aesthetic.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Heavy Slab Serif Typography] + [Torn Paper Header] + [Muted Vintage Photography] for a retro-editorial aesthetic.
